# `factory/routes.py`

[As built](../../README.md) › [Execution environment and infrastructure](../../subsystems/execution-environment-and-infrastructure.md) › `routes.py`

As built at `4b8570d19ee1`, read 2026-10-07.

Determines whether routes (CLI tools and API endpoints that access LLM models) are installed and connected; distinguishes between tool-not-found, not-signed-in, and other errors so each has an actionable next step; caches checks on disk so the console can show status without spending a turn.
